description_en: Queries vulnerability scanning tasks under the current Alibaba Cloud account by paged query
description_zh: 分页查询当前阿里云账号下的漏洞扫描任务
name: ListVulScanTasks

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 10000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时显示的当前页的页码。取值：1~10000
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 1000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页数量。取值：1~1000
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The task name. Fuzzy match is supported. The name can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 任务名称，支持模糊查询。长度不超过128个字符
parameters.name: task_name

parameters.help_en: The vulnerability scanning task IDs used for filtering. A maximum of 100 IDs can be specified. Duplicate IDs are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 按漏洞扫描任务ID过滤，最多包含100个，不允许重复
parameters.name: task_ids

parameters.help_en:
Filters by task type. Valid values:
Instant: an instant task created by CreateVulScanTask.
Scheduled: a scheduled task automatically created by a vulnerability scheduled scan policy on a periodic basis
parameters.help_zh:
按任务类型过滤。取值：
Instant：即时任务，由CreateVulScanTask创建。
Scheduled：定时任务，由漏洞定时扫描策略按周期自动创建
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en:
Filters by the matching mode of the effective scope. Valid values:
UserGroupAll: applies to all users under the current Alibaba Cloud account.
UserGroupNormal: applies only to users within specified user groups
parameters.help_zh:
按生效范围的匹配方式过滤。取值：
UserGroupAll：对当前阿里云账号下的全部用户生效。
UserGroupNormal：仅对指定用户组内的用户生效
parameters.name: match_mode

parameters.help_en:
Filters by task status. Valid values:
Running: the task is in progress and still within the validity period.
Expired: the task has expired and exceeded the validity period.
Canceled: the task has been canceled
parameters.help_zh:
按任务状态过滤。取值：
Running：进行中，任务仍在有效期内。
Expired：已失效，任务已超出有效期。
Canceled：已取消
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the vulnerability scheduled scan policy. This parameter is used to filter tasks triggered by the specified policy. Valid values are obtained from:
[ListVulScanScheduledStrategies](~~ListVulScanScheduledStrategies~~): lists vulnerability scheduled scan policies.
[CreateVulScanScheduledStrategy](~~CreateVulScanScheduledStrategy~~): creates a vulnerability scheduled scan policy
parameters.help_zh:
漏洞定时扫描策略ID，用于筛选由该策略触发的任务。取值来源：
[ListVulScanScheduledStrategies](~~ListVulScanScheduledStrategies~~)：批量查询漏洞定时扫描策略。
[CreateVulScanScheduledStrategy](~~CreateVulScanScheduledStrategy~~)：创建漏洞定时扫描策略
parameters.name: scheduled_strategy_id

parameters.help_en:
The user group ID. This parameter is used to filter records whose effective scope includes the specified user group. Valid values are obtained from:
[ListUserGroups](~~ListUserGroups~~): lists user groups
parameters.help_zh:
用户组ID，用于筛选生效范围包含该用户组的记录。取值来源：
[ListUserGroups](~~ListUserGroups~~)：批量查询用户组
parameters.name: user_group_id

Tasks.description_en: The list of vulnerability scanning tasks

CreateTime.description_en: The task creation time, in seconds-level UNIX timestamp
CreateTime.description_zh: 任务创建时间，秒级Unix时间戳

CustomMatchGroup.description_en: The effective scope specified by organizational structure. An empty list is returned if no organizational structure is configured
CustomMatchGroup.description_zh: 按组织架构指定的生效范围。未按组织架构配置时返回空列表

Group.description_en: The collection of organizational structure nodes

items.description_en: The DN of the organizational structure node

EndTimestamp.description_en: The task expiration time, in seconds-level UNIX timestamp. After this time, endpoints no longer pull and execute this task
EndTimestamp.description_zh: 任务失效时间，秒级Unix时间戳。到达该时间后终端不再拉取执行本任务

MatchMode.description_en:
The matching mode of the effective scope. Valid values:
UserGroupAll: applies to all users under the current Alibaba Cloud account.
UserGroupNormal: applies only to users within specified user groups
MatchMode.description_zh:
生效范围的匹配方式。取值：
UserGroupAll：对当前阿里云账号下的全部用户生效。
UserGroupNormal：仅对指定用户组内的用户生效

MatchTargetIds.description_en: The collection of effective user group IDs. An empty list is returned when MatchMode is UserGroupAll
MatchTargetIds.description_zh: 生效的用户组ID集合。MatchMode取值为UserGroupAll时返回空列表

ScheduledStrategyId.description_en: The ID of the vulnerability scheduled scan policy that triggered this task. An empty string is returned when TaskType is Instant
ScheduledStrategyId.description_zh: 触发该任务的漏洞定时扫描策略ID。TaskType取值为Instant时返回空字符串

Status.description_en:
The task status. Valid values:
Running: the task is in progress and still within the validity period.
Expired: the task has expired and exceeded the validity period.
Canceled: the task has been canceled
Status.description_zh:
任务状态。取值：
Running：进行中，任务仍在有效期内。
Expired：已失效，任务已超出有效期。
Canceled：已取消

TargetDeviceCount.description_en: The execution statistics of this task on user endpoint devices within the effective scope
TargetDeviceCount.description_zh: 本任务在生效范围内各用户终端设备上的执行情况统计

AckCount.description_en: The number of user endpoint devices that have acknowledged receipt of this task
AckCount.description_zh: 已确认接收本任务的用户终端设备数

FailCount.description_en: The number of user endpoint devices on which the scan failed
FailCount.description_zh: 扫描失败的用户终端设备数

StartCount.description_en: The number of user endpoint devices currently executing the scan. This value is calculated by subtracting SuccessCount and FailCount from AckCount
StartCount.description_zh: 正在执行扫描的用户终端设备数，由AckCount减去SuccessCount与FailCount得到

SuccessCount.description_en: The number of user endpoint devices on which the scan succeeded
SuccessCount.description_zh: 扫描成功的用户终端设备数

TaskDescription.description_en: The task description. An empty string is returned if no description is specified
TaskDescription.description_zh: 任务描述。未填写时返回空字符串
TaskDescription.example: 对研发部门终端执行一次漏洞扫描

TaskType.description_en:
The task type. Valid values:
Instant: an instant task created by CreateVulScanTask.
Scheduled: a scheduled task automatically created by a vulnerability scheduled scan policy on a periodic basis
TaskType.description_zh:
任务类型。取值：
Instant：即时任务，由CreateVulScanTask创建。
Scheduled：定时任务，由漏洞定时扫描策略按周期自动创建

VulCount.description_en: The total number of vulnerabilities detected by this task
VulCount.description_zh: 本任务累计检出的漏洞数

Whitelist.description_en: The list of exempted users. Users in this list are excluded from the scan. An empty list is returned if no exemption is configured
Whitelist.description_zh: 例外用户名单，名单内的用户不执行本次扫描。未配置时返回空列表

TotalNum.description_en: The total number of vulnerability scanning tasks that match the query conditions
TotalNum.description_zh: 符合查询条件的漏洞扫描任务总数
